note: How big a drawn object becomes in the world, in pixels, per entity id.
The drawing is scaled to FIT inside this box (drawing_skin_2d.gd takes the smaller
of the two ratios), so the box is a maximum and the aspect of what the player drew
is preserved. It is NOT a stretch.
This file exists because 21 of the 27 utilities share objects/utility_object.tscn,
whose default was 96x96 for everything. A bridge drawn as a long horizontal span
was therefore squashed into a 96px box and came out far too small to reach across
anything -- and a scene-level export cannot tell those 21 entities apart.
The numbers come from what the object is FOR. A bridge has to out-reach the
wanderer's 228px jump or it is not a bridge; a ladder has to out-reach its 94px
jump height. Sizes are compared against those two numbers, not chosen by eye.
